dependencies.note: The entire new pipeline (modular_polynomials.py, velu_verify.py, compute_delta_e.py) uses only the Python standard library, matching EXP-SSIQ-58b642's deliberate choice to keep the Fp2 field arithmetic, the modular-polynomial evaluation, and the Velu-formula independent verification fully auditable in pure Python and bit-reproducible without a floating-point-library-version confound. Network access (curl) was used only during development to fetch and vendor the modpoly_data/*.txt source files (see source_access_log.yaml); the primary_execution command itself performs no network access, reading only the vendored files under implementation/modpoly_data/.

resource_caps_applied.note: spec budget: wall_clock_seconds_per_run=7200, maximum_memory_gb=4. Neither cap was hit; actual wall clock was ~90.6s.

curl_version_used_for_modpoly_fetch: system curl, TLS verification never disabled, HTTPS_PROXY never unset (per environment notes and docs/claims-and-verification.md network policy)
